literal_meaning: পেটের ভাত চালে পরিণত হওয়া (the cooked rice in the stomach turns back into uncooked paddy)
figurative_meaning_en: To be extremely terrified and panicked due to apprehension or evil foreboding
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষার আগের রাতে তার পেটের ভাত চাল হয়ে গিয়েছিল ভয়ে।
খারাপ খবর শুনে তার পেটের ভাত চাল হওয়ার মতো ভয় লেগেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The night before the exam, he was so terrified that his stomach turned to knots with fear.
Upon hearing the bad news, she was gripped by such panic that it felt like her insides were churning in dread.
note: This idiom draws from the rural Bengali context where rice is a staple food, symbolizing extreme fear causing physical distress akin to indigestion.
